mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations, increasing equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average, the economy is in a labor-demand mismatch, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative in instances where UNRATE > 5.0 and RSAFS < 12mo_MA(RSAFS) (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation rate > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL_YoY > 3.0%) (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO growth rate > 0.5% MoM (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% QoQ (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2100 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110, the economy is in a demand-supply contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 2100 and INDPRO < 110 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
